scope: Source-parameter HFA reconstruction and arbitrary finite-basis representation controls only

HFA.notation: I is used literally as in LAW20, not F14 sqrt(I(I+1))
HFA.analytic_bound: f(n,I)>=(2n+1)/I only for both local curvatures positive

SSS.source: F24 PDF p14 Eqs.26-27, finite-angle probability density
SSS.kernel: sin(D*phi/2)^2 / (2*pi*D*sin(phi/2)^2), with its continuous limit at phi=0

boundaries: No full PTR/QTR eigenstates, physical transition operators or experimental likelihood were computed.
A large HFA diagnostic challenges a specified harmonic approximation, not all topological wobbling definitions.
SSS basis localization differs from Bogoliubov squeezing of a Hamiltonian eigenstate.
No new data or independence is created by changing the representation of a given density matrix.
